lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jin man vasiaa se jan sohe hiradai naam vasaae ||3||
lines.translation: Those whose minds are filled with the Naam are beautiful; they enshrine the Naam within their hearts. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar dar mahal satiguroo dikhaaiaa ra(n)g siu raleeaa maanai ||
lines.translation: The True Guru has revealed to me the Lord's Home and His Court, and the Mansion of His Presence. I joyfully enjoy His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh kahai s bhalaa kar maanai naanak naam vakhaanai ||4||6||16||
lines.translation: Whatever He says, I accept as good; Nanak chants the Naam. ||4||6||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਲੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: manasaa manahi samaai lai gurasabadee veechaar ||
lines.translation: The desires of the mind are absorbed in the mind, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur poore te sojhee pavai phir marai na vaaro vaar ||1||
lines.translation: Understanding is obtained from the Perfect Guru, and then the mortal does not die over and over again. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere raam naam aadhaar ||
lines.translation: My mind takes the Support of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaad param pad paaiaa sabh ichh pujaavanahaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the supreme status; the Lord is the Fulfiller of all desires. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh mahi eko rav rahiaa gur bin boojh na paai ||
lines.translation: The One Lord is permeating and pervading amongst all; without the Guru, this understanding is not obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh pragat hoaa meraa har prabh anadin har gun gaai ||2||
lines.translation: My Lord God has been revealed to me, and I have become Gurmukh. Night and day, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukhadaataa har ek hai hor thai sukh na paahi ||
lines.translation: The One Lord is the Giver of peace; peace is not found anywhere else.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: satigur jinee na seviaa daataa se a(n)t gae pachhutaahi ||3||
lines.translation: Those who do not serve the Giver, the True Guru, depart regretfully in the end. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਧਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sev sadaa sukh paaiaa phir dukh na laagai dhaai ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, lasting peace is obtained, and the mortal does not suffer in pain any longer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har bhagat paraapat hoee jotee jot samaai ||4||7||17||
lines.translation: Nanak has been blessed with devotional worship of the Lord; his light has merged into the Light. ||4||7||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ਭੂਲਾ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: baajh guroo jagat bauraanaa bhoolaa chotaa khaaee ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, the world is insane; confused and deluded, it is beaten, and it suffers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਦਰ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mar mar ja(n)mai sadaa dukh paae dar kee khabar na paaee ||1||
lines.translation: It dies and dies again, and is reborn, always in pain, but it is unaware of the Lord's Gate. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man sadaa rahahu satigur kee saranaa ||
lines.translation: O my mind, remain always in the Protection of the True Guru's Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਸਦ ਲਾਗਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hiradai har naam meethaa sad laagaa gurasabade bhavajal taranaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Those people, to whose hearts the Lord's Name seems sweet, are carried across the terrifying world-ocean by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਡੋਲੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhekh karai bahut chit dolai a(n)tar kaam krodh aha(n)kaar ||
lines.translation: The mortal wears various religious robes, but his consciousness is unsteady; deep within, he is filled with sexual desire, anger and egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਿਸਾ ਭੂਖ ਅਤਿ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਭਉਕਤ ਫਿਰੈ ਦਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar tisaa bhookh at bahutee bhaukat phirai dar baar ||2||
lines.translation: Deep within is the great thirst and immense hunger; he wanders from door to door. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad marahi phir jeevahi tin kau mukat duaar ||
lines.translation: Those who die in the Word of the Guru's Shabad are reborn; they find the door of liberation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar saa(n)t sadaa sukh hovai har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||3||
lines.translation: With constant peace and tranquility deep within, they enshrine the Lord within their hearts. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵੈ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu tis bhaavai tivai chalaavai karanaa kichhoo na jaaee ||
lines.translation: As it pleases Him, He inspires us to act. Nothing else can be done.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh sabad samhaale raam naam vadiaaee ||4||8||18||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh contemplates the Word of the Shabad, and is blessed with the glorious greatness of the Lord's Name. ||4||8||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਟੇ ਦੁਖ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai maaiaa mohi khuaaiaa dukh khate dukh khaai ||
lines.translation: Lost in egotism, Maya and attachment, the mortal earns pain, and eats pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭ ਹਲਕੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਭਰਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar lobh halak dukh bhaaree bin bibek bharamaai ||1||
lines.translation: The great disease, the rabid disease of greed, is deep within him; he wanders around indiscriminately. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੈਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh dhrig jeevan saisaar ||
lines.translation: The life of the self-willed manmukh in this world is cursed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam supanai nahee chetiaa har siu kade na laagai piaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He does not remember the Lord's Name, even in his dreams. He is never in love with the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਸੂਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕੂੜੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pasooaa karam karai nahee boojhai kooR kamaavai kooRo hoi ||
lines.translation: He acts like a beast, and does not understand anything. Practicing falsehood, he becomes false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਉਲਟੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: satigur milai ta ulatee hovai khoj lahai jan koi ||2||
lines.translation: But when the mortal meets the True Guru, his way of looking at the world changes. How rare are those humble beings who seek and find the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਦ ਵਸਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam ridai sad vasiaa paaiaa gunee nidhaan ||
lines.translation: That person, whose heart is forever filled with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, obtains the Lord, the Treasure of Virtue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee pooraa paaiaa chookaa man abhimaan ||3||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, he finds the Perfect Lord; the egotistical pride of his mind is eradicated. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape karataa kare karaae aape maarag paae ||
lines.translation: The Creator Himself acts, and causes all to act. He Himself places us on the path.
